gate.name: The Gate
gate.desc: A cold wind follows you in. A hall lies north.

hall.name: The Hall
hall.desc: Dust covers the floor. A vault door is east, and a tower stair is north.

tower.name: The Tower
tower.desc: A narrow stair climbs into the dark. Nothing else is here.

vault.name: The Vault
vault.desc: Gold heaps around a stone chest.
